jars: The script says 'ten-minute call that ended your life' — too dramatic for a layoff.
The Ramayana story on Day 7 calls Ram's exile 'freedom' — this is deeply insensitive to someone facing a home loan and an 11th-grade daughter.
Day 5's advice to 'speak to one person' ignores the very real Indian family dynamic of hiding bad news from parents to protect them.
best: Your body wakes at six because it is still loyal. It is not failing you. It is carrying the shock of a world turned upside down.
day1_verdict: This finally named the 6 AM wake-up call and the unspoken shame of hiding it from my mother.
